Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements of trochanteric reamer, used in orthopaedic 
surgery. 

2. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30CM3 of IS: 6603-1972 ' Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats '. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. T. ?

FIG. 1 REAMER, TROCHANTERIC, ORTHOPAEDIC 

4. Heat Treatment — The reamer shall be hardened and tempered to 450 to 500 HV. 

5. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The reamer shall be made in one piece. 

5.2 All the surfaces of the reamer shall be free from pits, burrs, cracks and other surface defects. 

5.3 The cutting edge of the reamer shall be properly sharpened and shall be free from nicks and 
waviness. 

5.4 AH other edges shall be even. 

5.5 Reamer shall be passivated and finished smooth and bright. 

6. Test 

6.1 Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub a reamer sample with soap and warm water, tinse in *ot water 
and then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at room 
temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool.

The copper sulphate solution shall be -prepared as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuS0 4 .5H,0 ) 4*0 g 

Sulphuric acid ( H s S0 4 ) ( sp gr 1*84 ) 100 g 

Distilled water [ see IS : 1070-1960 Specification for 900 ml 

water, distilled quality ( revised ) ] 

There shall be no red stains or spots on the sample but dulling of the polished surface may be permitted. 

7. Marking — The reamer shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trademark, 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with Indian Standards Institution 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
